claims.claim: RST_STREAM, including NO_ERROR, received before actual EOS transitions to Error(remote_reset).
Only received END_STREAM states (including a later error after such EOS) satisfy is_recv_end_stream.
ensure_recv_open returns Err for Error, including the early NO_ERROR reset; it returns false for received EOS states.
poll_data can return None for queued trailers without consulting terminal stream state.
Trailers and schedule_recv subsequently consult ensure_recv_open; is_end_stream also requires no queued receive events.
The client therefore requires all data results Ok, trailers completed/empty, is_end_stream true and exact Content-Length; None alone never qualifies.
